_about: Reviewed fixes for typos in AELF's references, applied by harvest_aelf.py and listed in fill_report.md.

gospel_acclamation.why: AELF (2021-05-26) gives 'cf. Mt 10, 45', but Matthew 10 has 42 verses; the Gospel that day is Mark 10:32-45.

first_reading.why: AELF (2026-09-08) gives 'Rm 8, 28,30'; the reading is Romans 8:28-30.

gospel.why: AELF (2026-08-29) gives 'Mc 6, 17, 29'; the Gospel is Mark 6:17-29.
